Ask a chatbot who won yesterday's electi.zh: 问聊天机器人昨天选举谁获胜，它会自信地编造一个答案。解决之道？在它作答@@T0@@之前@@T1@@把正确的文档交给它。这就是 RAG—检索增强生成—而你可以用两个早已熟悉的思想把它搭建出来。
Ask a chatbot who won yesterday's electi.src: Ask a chatbot who won yesterday's election and it confidently makes something up. The fix? Give it the right documents before it answers. That's RAG—retrieval-augmented generation—and you can build it from two ideas you already know.

Drag points, switch domains, and watch t.zh: 拖动数据点、切换领域，观察词元的逐步生成。流水线的每个步骤都是可交互的。
Drag points, switch domains, and watch t.src:
Drag points, switch domains, and watch token generation unfold. Every

A language model's knowledge is baked in.zh: 语言模型的知识在训练期间被固化在权重之中。训练一旦结束，这些权重便被冻结。由此产生三个在实践中反复出现的问题：
A language model's knowledge is baked in.src:
A language model's knowledge is baked into its weights during training.
          Once training ends, those weights are frozen. This creates three problems
          that show up constantly in practice:

@@T0@@Stale knowledge.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@知识过时。@@T1@@
              询问训练截止日期之后发生的事，模型一无所知。它要么拒绝回答，要么更糟—自信地瞎猜。
@@T0@@Stale knowledge.@@T1@@\n.src: Stale knowledge. Ask about something that happened after the training cutoff and the model has no idea. It will either refuse or, worse, guess confidently.

@@T0@@Missing domain facts.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@缺失领域事实。@@T1@@
              你公司的内部文档、一篇小众研究论文、某座新城市的
              公交时刻表—这些都不在训练数据之中。
@@T0@@Missing domain facts.@@T1@@\n.src: Missing domain facts. Your company's internal docs, a niche research paper, a new city's bus schedule—none of it was in the training data.

@@T0@@Hallucination.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@幻觉。@@T1@@
              当模型不知道某事时，它往往不去说「我不知道」，而是编造一个听起来合理
              却错误的答案。
@@T0@@Hallucination.@@T1@@\n.src: Hallucination. When the model doesn't know something, it often invents a plausible-sounding but wrong answer instead of saying "I don't know."

@@T0@@The core idea.@@T1@@\n In.zh:
@@T0@@核心思想。@@T1@@
          与其在知识每次变化时都重新训练模型，不如让它参加一场
          @@T2@@开卷考试@@T3@@。在查询时取回相关文档，
          并将它们粘贴进提示词。模型阅读这些文本并据此作答—而非凭记忆作答。这就是 RAG。
@@T0@@The core idea.@@T1@@\n In.src: The core idea. Instead of retraining the model every time knowledge changes, give it an open-book exam. Fetch the relevant documents at query time and paste them into the prompt. The model reads them and answers from the text—not from memory. That is RAG.

RAG combines exactly two ideas. If you'v.zh: RAG 恰好组合了两个思想。如果你上过机器学习入门课程，两者你都已经知道。在把它们连接起来之前，我们先确认对它们的理解一致。
RAG combines exactly two ideas. If you'v.src:
RAG combines exactly two ideas. If you've taken an intro ML course, you
          already know both. Let's make sure we agree on them before wiring them
          together.

Next-token prediction (LM).zh: 下一词元预测（语言模型）

A language model takes a sequence of tok.zh: 语言模型接收一个词元序列，并预测接下来是什么。GPT、LLaMA、Claude—它们都以此方式工作，一次预测一个词元。模型「所知道」的一切都存在于其权重之中。这被称为 @@T0@@参数化记忆@@T1@@—训练结束后便固定下来。
A language model takes a sequence of tok.src: A language model takes a sequence of tokens and predicts what comes next. GPT, LLaMA, Claude—they all work this way, one token at a time. Everything the model "knows" lives in its weights. This is called parametric memory—fixed once training ends.

Represent items as vectors (points in sp.zh:
将项目表示为向量（空间中的点）。给定一个查询向量，
              找出最近的 k 个点。查询时无需学习—纯粹的
              几何。若两份文档主题相近，它们的向量
              便会彼此靠近。
Represent items as vectors (points in sp.src:
Represent items as vectors (points in space). Given a query vector,
              find the k closest points. No learning at query time—pure
              geometry. If two documents are about similar topics, their vectors
              will be close together.

@@T0@@Pause and think.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@暂停思考。@@T1@@
          语言模型能生成流畅的文本，却可能凭空捏造事实。kNN 能找到
          相关文档，却写不出句子。RAG 将二者串联：
          kNN 检索事实，语言模型将其转化为答案。
          二者单独都无法完成这项任务。
@@T0@@Pause and think.@@T1@@\n.src: Pause and think. The LM generates fluent text but can hallucinate facts. kNN finds relevant documents but can't write sentences. RAG chains them: kNN retrieves the facts, and the LM turns them into an answer. Neither can do the job alone.

Five steps. We'll walk through each one.zh: 共五步。我们将交互式地逐一走过每一步。
Five steps. We'll walk through each one.src: Five steps. We'll walk through each one interactively.

There are two stages. @@T0@@Offline@@T1@.zh:
共分两个阶段。@@T0@@离线阶段@@T1@@（只做一次）：嵌入全部
          文档，并将其存入可检索的索引。
          @@T2@@在线阶段@@T3@@（查询时）：将用户的问题
          推过整条流水线。我们逐步搭建这两者。
There are two stages. @@T0@@Offline@@T1@.src: There are two stages. Offline (done once): embed all your documents and store them in a searchable index. Online (at query time): push the user's question through the full pipeline. Let's build both, step by step.

First, pick a domain. This determines th.zh: 首先，选择一个领域。这决定了语料库（模型可检索的文档集合）：
First, pick a domain. This determines th.src:
First, pick a domain. This determines the corpus (the documents the

Here are the five documents in our mini-corpus. In a real system, you'd

An @@T0@@encoder model@@T1@@ (like Sente.zh:
@@T0@@编码器模型@@T1@@（如 Sentence-BERT）读取每份
          文档并输出一个 @@T2@@向量@@T3@@—一串捕捉文档语义的

An @@T0@@encoder model@@T1@@ (like Sente.src: An encoder model (like Sentence-BERT) reads each document and outputs a vector—a list of numbers that captures the document's meaning. Documents about similar topics produce similar vectors. In real systems these are 768-dimensional or more, but to keep things visual we'll use 2D embeddings.

下方每个蓝点是一份文档，按其二维嵌入坐标

Each blue dot below is a document, plotted at its 2D embedding

@@T0@@docs = split(corpus) @@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@docs  = split(corpus)       @@T1@@# 将文本切分为段落@@T2@@
emb   = encoder(docs)       @@T3@@# 嵌入每个块 → 向量@@T4@@
index = FAISS(emb)          @@T5@@# 构建可检索的索引@@T6@@@@T7@@
@@T0@@docs = split(corpus) @@T1@@.src: docs = split(corpus) # chunk text into passages emb = encoder(docs) # embed each chunk → vector index = FAISS(emb) # build a searchable index

@@T0@@What makes a good embedding?@@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@什么样的嵌入才算好？@@T1@@
          「德里的冬季 PM2.5」应当落在「加尔各答的冬季雾霾」附近，而远离
          「玫瑰奶球是油炸的」。编码器在其自身于大规模文本语料上的训练过程中
          学会了这些距离。
@@T0@@What makes a good embedding?@@T1@@.src: What makes a good embedding? "Delhi PM2.5 in winter" should land near "Kolkata winter smog" and far from "Gulab jamun is deep-fried." The encoder learns these distances during its own training on large text corpora.

A user asks a question. We pass it throu.zh:
用户提出一个问题。我们将其通过@@T0@@同一个@@T1@@编码器
          以获得查询向量。由于编码器将语义相近的文本映射到邻近的点，
          查询便会落在相关文档附近。
A user asks a question. We pass it throu.src: A user asks a question. We pass it through the same encoder to get a query vector. Because the encoder maps semantically similar text to nearby points, the query will land close to relevant documents.

Now both the documents and the query liv.zh:

          下方是二维嵌入画布。@@T0@@橙色点@@T1@@
          是查询；蓝色点是文档。
          @@T2@@拖动橙色查询点@@T3@@ 进行探索—最近的两份
          文档将实时以距离线高亮显示。
Now both the documents and the query liv.src: Now both the documents and the query live in the same vector space. Below is the 2D embedding canvas. The orange dot is the query; the blue dots are documents. Drag the orange query point to explore—the two nearest documents will be highlighted with distance lines in real time.

Sort by distance. The top-k (here k=2) c.zh:
按距离排序。最近的 top-k（此处 k=2）份文档「胜出」，
          成为我们检索到的上下文。以下是实时的距离表—拖动
          上方的查询点，观察它如何更新：
Sort by distance. The top-k (here k=2) c.src:
Sort by distance. The top-k (here k=2) closest documents "win" and
          become our retrieved context. Here's the live distance table—drag
          the query point above and watch it update:

@@T0@@Why top-k, not all?@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@为何取 top-k 而非全部？@@T1@@
          语言模型的上下文窗口有限（通常为 4K–128K 词元）。我们
          无法粘贴每一份文档，因此只选取最相关的 k 份。
          选择 k 是一种权衡：太小会遗漏上下文；太大
          则无关文档会淹没信号。
@@T0@@Why top-k, not all?@@T1@@\n.src: Why top-k, not all? LMs have a finite context window (typically 4K–128K tokens). We can't paste every document, so we pick the k most relevant ones. Choosing k is a trade-off: too small and you miss context; too large and irrelevant documents drown the signal.

This is where retrieval meets generation.zh:
这里是检索与生成交汇之处。我们取检索到的
          文档与用户的问题，将它们拼接成一个
          文本块—即语言模型将要阅读的提示词：
This is where retrieval meets generation.src:
This is where retrieval meets generation. We take the retrieved
          documents and the user's question and concatenate them into a single
          text block—the prompt that the LM will read:

@@T0@@q_emb = encoder(query).zh:
@@T0@@q_emb  = encoder(query)            @@T1@@# 第 2 步：嵌入查询@@T2@@
docs   = index.search(q_emb, k=2)  @@T3@@# 第 3 步：检索 top-2@@T4@@
prompt = concat(docs, query)        @@T5@@# 第 4 步：组装提示词@@T6@@
output = LLM(prompt)                @@T7@@# 第 5 步：生成答案@@T8@@@@T9@@
@@T0@@q_emb = encoder(query).src: q_emb = encoder(query) # step 2: embed the query docs = index.search(q_emb, k=2) # step 3: retrieve top-2 prompt = concat(docs, query) # step 4: assemble prompt output = LLM(prompt) # step 5: generate answer

After prompt assembly, @@T0@@RAG's retri.zh:
提示词组装完成后，@@T0@@RAG 的检索任务便告结束@@T1@@。
          此后便是标准的语言建模—语言模型阅读
          提示词，逐词元生成答案。
After prompt assembly, @@T0@@RAG's retri.src: After prompt assembly, RAG's retrieval job is done. From here on it's standard language modelling—the LM reads the prompt and generates an answer, one token at a time.

The LM generates tokens one at a time, conditioned on the full prompt
          (context + question). Mathematically, it's still plain next-token
          prediction:

But the context tokens profoundly change.zh:
但上下文词元深刻地改变了@@T0@@哪些@@T1@@词元
          更可能出现。没有上下文时，模型可能产生幻觉。有了上下文，它

But the context tokens profoundly change.src: But the context tokens profoundly change which tokens are likely. Without context, the model might hallucinate. With context, it can ground its answer in real text. Click to watch generation unfold:

Tokens @@T0@@highlighted in green@@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@以绿色高亮@@T1@@的词元直接
          来自检索到的上下文。模型并非在做字面意义上的「复制」—只是
          在下一词元预测下，上下文使这些特定词语
          变得极可能出现。
Tokens @@T0@@highlighted in green@@T1@@.src: Tokens highlighted in green come directly from the retrieved context. The model isn't "copying" in a literal sense—it's just that the context makes those specific words overwhelmingly likely under next-token prediction.

How does the LM use the context?.zh: 语言模型如何使用上下文？
How does the LM use the context?.src: How does the LM use the context?

Through @@T0@@self-attention@@T1@@. When.zh:
通过 @@T0@@自注意力机制@@T1@@。在生成每个输出
          词元时，模型会关注提示词中的所有词元—包括
          检索到的文档。它自然地聚焦于最相关的上下文
          词元：
Through @@T0@@self-attention@@T1@@. When.src: Through self-attention. When generating each output token, the model attends to all tokens in the prompt—including the retrieved documents. It naturally focuses on the most relevant context tokens:

Darker cells = higher attention weight..zh:
单元格颜色越深 = 注意力权重越高。当模型生成
          「Delhi」时，它会高度关注上下文中的「Delhi」。当它生成
          「PM2.5」时，它会关注「PM2.5」。注意力机制正是
          RAG 在神经网络层面得以奏效的原因。
Darker cells = higher attention weight..src:
Darker cells = higher attention weight. When the model generates
          "Delhi," it attends heavily to "Delhi" in the context. When it generates
          "PM2.5," it attends to "PM2.5." The attention mechanism is what makes
          RAG work at the neural network level.

Side by side: with vs. without RAG.src: Side by side: with vs. without RAG

The model relies solely on its weights..src: The model relies solely on its weights. May hallucinate or hedge.

@@T0@@Instruction tuning matters.@@T1@@\.zh:
@@T0@@指令微调至关重要。@@T1@@
          基座语言模型可能会把提示词当作某份文档的一部分来续写，
          而不是回答问题。经过指令微调的
          模型已然学会「上下文 + 问题 → 答案」。
          下一词元预测的数学不变，但权重经过对齐，以产出

@@T0@@Instruction tuning matters.@@T1@@\.src: Instruction tuning matters. A base LM might continue the prompt as though it were part of a document, rather than answering the question. An instruction-tuned model has learned "Context + Question → Answer." Same next-token prediction math, but the weights are aligned to produce helpful answers.

The beauty of RAG is that the pipeline is domain-agnostic. Swap the

The intuition is simple: instead of aski.src:

@@T0@@The one-line summary.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@一句话总结。@@T1@@
          RAG = 对知识做 kNN + 对文本做语言模型。
          参数化记忆（模型所学）+ 非参数化记忆
          （你刚刚检索到的内容）。
@@T0@@The one-line summary.@@T1@@\n.src: The one-line summary. RAG = kNN over knowledge + LM over text. Parametric memory (what the model learned) + non-parametric memory (what you retrieved just now).

RAG is powerful, but it's not magic. Und.zh:
RAG 强大，但并非魔法。理解其失效模式
          将为你省下大量调试时间：
RAG is powerful, but it's not magic. Und.src:
RAG is powerful, but it's not magic. Understanding the failure modes
          will save you hours of debugging:

1. The retriever fetches wrong documents.zh: 1. 检索器取回错误的文档

If the embedding model doesn't understan.zh:
若嵌入模型对你的领域理解不足，它
              可能检索到表面上相似但语义上错误的文档。
              垃圾上下文输入 → 垃圾答案输出。
              @@T0@@嵌入模型的质量就是 RAG 性能的上限。@@T1@@
If the embedding model doesn't understan.src: If the embedding model doesn't understand your domain well, it may retrieve documents that look similar on the surface but are semantically wrong. Garbage context in → garbage answer out. The embedding model's quality is the ceiling for RAG.

Stuffing too many documents into the pro.zh:
向提示词塞入过多文档会使注意力被摊薄。
              那一份相关文档被掩埋在九份无关文档之中。
              更小、更精确的 k 常常胜过更大的 k。
Stuffing too many documents into the pro.src:
Stuffing too many documents into the prompt spreads attention thin.
              The one relevant document gets buried among nine irrelevant ones.
              Smaller, more precise k often beats larger k.

Five documents that all say the same thi.zh:
五份内容雷同的文档会占用宝贵的上下文
              窗口，却不增添任何新信息。多样性感知的检索
              （如 MMR—最大边际相关性）对此有所帮助。
Five documents that all say the same thi.src:
Five documents that all say the same thing use up precious context
              window without adding new information. Diversity-aware retrieval
              (like MMR—maximal marginal relevance) helps.

If the answer requires combining facts f.zh:
若答案需要综合文档 A 与文档 B 中的
              事实，语言模型往往力不能及。它倾向于从单份
              文档中抄袭，而非跨多份文档进行综合。这是一个
              活跃的研究方向。
If the answer requires combining facts f.src:
If the answer requires combining facts from document A and
              document B, the LM often fails. It tends to copy from one
              document rather than synthesise across several. This is an
              active area of research.

@@T0@@Citations are not proof.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@引用并不等于证据。@@T1@@
          即便模型写下「[来源 1]」，它也可能引用了错误的文档，
          或曲解了该文档的内容。语言模型输出中的引用是一种习得的
          输出模式，而非一种有据可依的机制。务必核实。
@@T0@@Citations are not proof.@@T1@@\n.src: Citations are not proof. Even if the model writes "[Source 1]," it may cite the wrong document or misrepresent what it says. Citations in LM output are a learned output pattern, not a grounding mechanism. Always verify.

@@T0@@RAG = Retrieval + Generation.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@RAG = 检索 + 生成。@@T1@@ 在嵌入空间中找出最近的
            文档，将其粘贴进提示词，然后让
            语言模型依据文本作答。
@@T0@@RAG = Retrieval + Generation.@@T1@.src: RAG = Retrieval + Generation. Find the nearest documents in embedding space, paste them into the prompt, and let the LM answer from the text.

@@T0@@Five steps.@@T1@@ Embed &rarr; Ind.zh:
@@T0@@五个步骤。@@T1@@ 嵌入 → 建索引 → 检索
            → 构建提示词 → 生成。
@@T0@@Five steps.@@T1@@ Embed &rarr; Ind.src: Five steps. Embed → Index → Retrieve → Build prompt → Generate.

@@T0@@Better input, not better model.@@T.zh:
@@T0@@改善输入，而非改善模型。@@T1@@ RAG 并不
            改变模型权重—它改变模型所看到的内容。
            底层的数学依旧是下一词元预测。
@@T0@@Better input, not better model.@@T.src: Better input, not better model. RAG doesn't change the model's weights—it changes what the model sees. The underlying math is still next-token prediction.

@@T0@@Attention is the mechanism.@@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@注意力机制是其机理。@@T1@@ 语言模型通过
            自注意力机制关注上下文词元，自然地将相关事实
            引入其输出。
@@T0@@Attention is the mechanism.@@T1@@.src: Attention is the mechanism. The LM attends to context tokens via self-attention, naturally copying relevant facts into its output.

@@T0@@Know the limits.@@T1@@ Bad embeddi.zh:
@@T0@@认清其局限。@@T1@@ 劣质嵌入、稀释的上下文、
            冗余文档以及多跳推理，正是 RAG 失效之处。
            没有任何工具是万灵药。
@@T0@@Know the limits.@@T1@@ Bad embeddi.src: Know the limits. Bad embeddings, diluted context, redundant docs, and multi-hop reasoning are where RAG breaks down. No tool is a silver bullet.

meta.title: 从零实现 RAG
meta.tagline: 检索近邻、以条件约束语言模型 —— 检索增强生成的实际工作原理
meta.summary: 逐步演示如何用两个你早已熟悉的概念搭建 RAG：下一词元预测与 k 近邻。包含交互式二维嵌入、实时检索、提示词组装，以及跨越空气质量、烹饪与历史的示例。
highlights: 在二维嵌入空间中拖动查询点，观察 kNN 检索如何选出最近的文档。
查看完整流水线：嵌入、检索、构建提示词、生成 —— 每一步都配有具体示例。
在四个领域（空气质量、烹饪、历史、医学）之间切换，观察 RAG 如何适应不同的知识。
从概率角度理解 RAG 为何有效：参数化记忆 + 非参数化记忆。
